P2.why: MP P2: wide crack to a ledge with two large gnarled trees (good anchors); 'easy' unsupported, removed
P2.text: Belay on the ledge where two large, twisted trees stand, above the wide crack.

P2.5.why: MP P2.5: above right side of gnarled trees to a small bowl with a tall tree anchor; 'on its right' unsupported, removed
P2.5.text: The stance is a small bowl with a tall tree as the anchor, reached above the right side of the twisted trees.

P3.why: MP P3: belay on a small ledge after the hand-crack dihedral then shaft; the dihedral/shaft 'or' not clearly stated, so only the end-of-pitch ledge kept
P3.text: Belay on a small ledge at the top of the pitch.

2.why: MP pitch 2: climb the 4 inch plus cracks to a ledge out left; belay anchor on that ledge
2.text: The anchor is on a ledge out to the left, above the 4-inch cracks of the Western Dihedral.

3.why: MP pitch 3: finger traverse, bolt, dirty hump, smear past two bolts to the anchor
3.text: Belay at the anchor reached after the finger traverse, the dirty hump and the two bolts on the smear.

4.why: MP pitch 4: ramble ~40 m up slab, look right for a single bolt leading to the anchor
4.text: The anchor is reached by following a single bolt off to the right at the top of the long slab ramble.

5.why: MP pitch 5: belay at the summit is a sling around a pinch; 'near the summit block' not stated, changed to at the summit
5.text: A sling threaded around a rock pinch at the summit serves as the belay.
